product.name: Aurelio Radiance Mask 5% Vitamin C
product.description: The Aurelio Radiance Mask 5% Vitamin C delivers a potent antioxidant boost to the skin, targeting dullness and uneven tone. Packaged in a sleek 50 mL tube, the lightweight formula blends vitamin C with hyaluronic acid for instant hydration and a radiant glow. Users apply a thin layer to cleansed face and neck, leaving the skin supple and refreshed. The mask is free of parabens, sulfates, and artificial fragrances, making it suitable for sensitive complexions. Ideal for a weekly spa routine or a quick pick-up before a special event, this product helps reduce fine lines and promotes a smoother texture over time.
